label: baseline-an-05
concerns_note: every deck concern (anchors have no PPTX or repo); gates on all D criteria, judges only on this anchor's labelled S/T criteria (must_fail ∪ must_pass)
judge_model: Claude Opus 5.5 (generic general-purpose subagents, model inherited)
scope_source: PB-025 baseline part 1; presenter asleep, scope decided by the orchestrator for the presenter (answers the EVAL.md scope prompt; no prompt was asked)
sizes_note: judge screenshots at 1920x1080 (projected) and 1288x598 (short-wide Teams window); 1280x720 omitted to bound evidence, as its layout sits between the two. Gates render all three review sizes.
dispatch: each judge got one filled judges/output-judge.md prompt (stored in prompts/) by path, nothing else
units: one unit per labelled S/T criterion: the slide its label names (anchors.json 'where'); a must_pass label on a multi-slide anchor is therefore checked on one slide only
